title: Russia Strikes Kyiv Bridge in Daytime Drone Attack, Large Fireball Erupts
detail: Russia conducted fresh drone and missile strikes on Kyiv, directly hitting a bridge in a rare daytime attack that produced a large visible fireball. The strike caused significant damage and disruption to traffic infrastructure in the Ukrainian capital. Moscow simultaneously issued warnings of further retaliation following Ukrainian long-range drone strikes on Russian territory, including oil refineries and defense plants in recent days.

media.caption: Fireball erupts as Russian drone hits Kyiv bridge in daytime attack

title: Ukraine Frontline 'Kill Zone': Troops Shelter Underground as Drones Dominate No-Man's Land
detail: NPR reports on the attritional drone warfare conditions on Ukraine's front lines, where troops hunker underground as drones buzz overhead in a relentless contest. The 'Kill Zone' describes stretches of no-man's land where any surface movement draws immediate drone response, forcing soldiers to rely on underground networks for movement, limiting resupply and reinforcement operations and defining the slow, grinding nature of the current front.

title: Occupied Oleshky: Ukrainian Civilians Face Hunger, Drones, and Landmines Under Russian Control
detail: Al Jazeera reports on civilian conditions in Russia-occupied Oleshky in Kherson Oblast, where residents face severe food insecurity, persistent drone threats, and widespread landmine dangers. Cut off from Ukrainian government services and humanitarian aid, residents endure ongoing hardship under occupation with no clear path to relief.

media.caption: Civilians in Russian-occupied Oleshky face hunger, drone threats, and landmines

title: Day 1,685: Defense Express Reports Cumulative Russian Personnel Losses in Ukraine
detail: Defense Express publishes the day-1685 cumulative Russian military loss update for the war in Ukraine, continuing to track ongoing attrition across all active frontline sectors. Ukrainian military sources and open-source analysts monitor Russian personnel, armor, artillery, and logistical losses as the conflict grinds into its fourth year.
